summary.zh: 汇总 v0.453.0 之后的本地更新：消息排队与附件编辑、稳定的历史加载和滚动、会话后台交接与定时结果、OAuth 账号和模型目录修复，以及附件交付和七天活动历史保留。
summary.en: Consolidates the local changes after v0.453.0: queued input and attachment editing, stable history and scrolling, session-owned background work and automation, safer OAuth and model discovery, reliable file delivery, and seven-day activity retention.

source.releaseNotes: Release preparation; see docs/releases/v0.460.0.md for verification scope, retention behavior, and compatibility notes.

title.zh: 可编辑、可撤回的会话消息队列
title.en: Editable session-bound message queues

summary.zh: 忙时默认排队，支持排序、编辑和逐条发送；读取附件期间撤回有效，切会话不误投，也不重复发送。
summary.en: Queue while busy, reorder and edit pending messages, and send sequentially. Withdrawal during attachment loading works without cross-session delivery or duplicate sends.

title.zh: 当前任务交给后台继续
title.en: Hand current work to a background session

summary.zh: 隔离后台会话继承父会话权限；交接等待真正空闲，停止失败或超时就取消。
summary.en: Isolated background sessions inherit parent permissions. Handoff waits for real idleness and cancels when stopping fails or times out.

title.zh: 会话定时与固定位置的检查结果
title.en: Session timers with anchored results

summary.zh: 会话定时与巡查分区，检查结果回到原回合；修复检查状态残留、历史结论覆盖和确认卡隐藏。
summary.en: Separate session timers from patrol jobs and anchor results to their originating turns, with reliable check states, retained conclusions, and visible approval cards.

title.zh: 账号真实模型目录与统一参数参考
title.en: Account-derived catalogs and consistent model references

summary.zh: 在线查询优先使用账号目录，补齐本地模型资料；思考档、上下文与模态保留用户明确设置，修复旧目录版本漏掉 Sol。
summary.en: Prefer account-derived catalogs, expand local references, preserve explicit thinking/context/modality settings, and fix stale client-version discovery that omitted Sol.

details.zh: 目录条目不保证所有账号或渠道都能调用。
details.en: Catalog entries do not guarantee availability for every account or provider.

sources.title: Model reference lookup and OAuth discovery

title.zh: 新增 Meta 供应商入口
title.en: Add a Meta provider entry

summary.zh: 补入 Meta API Key 预设、Responses 接入与 Muse 模型参考，账号是否可用以实际渠道为准。
summary.en: Add the Meta API-key preset, Responses integration, and Muse model references, subject to actual provider availability.

title.zh: OAuth 账号刷新与速度权益不再串状态
title.en: Keep OAuth refresh and service-tier state scoped

summary.zh: 旧快照不再复活已删账号或撤销切号，优先使用活槽新凭证；Ultrafast 同时检查当前账号权益与模型支持。Grok 客户端标记升至 1.0.13，修复 426 版本拦截。
summary.en: Stale refresh snapshots no longer resurrect deleted accounts or undo switches. Prefer live credentials and gate Ultrafast by current-account entitlement and model support. Update the Grok client marker to 1.0.13 to fix HTTP 426 version rejection.

details.zh: 未知或普通套餐保留 Standard/Fast；高价套餐正向分支使用模拟响应验证。
details.en: Unknown and ordinary plans retain Standard/Fast; higher-tier positive cases were verified with simulated responses.

sources.title: OAuth vault races and Codex entitlement checks

title.zh: 补齐历史漏加载与上下滚动抽动
title.en: Fix missing history and unstable transcript scrolling

summary.zh: 首屏缺提问或不足一屏也能补页；按阅读消息保持位置，修正高度补偿、虚拟间距和停流折叠，保留正常贴底。
summary.en: Load older history even when the first page lacks the question or cannot scroll. Anchor reading position across prepends, virtual spacing, height changes, and stream-end folding while preserving bottom-follow behavior.

title.zh: 附件编辑、预览与交付语义补齐
title.en: Reliable attachment editing, previews, and delivery

summary.zh: 修复多图补读错位、删光附件仍带回和新图片丢失；交付兼容空占位，明确报告参数错误与部分失败。
summary.en: Fix reordered image recovery, deleted attachments reappearing, and lost pasted images. Delivery tolerates unused placeholders and reports invalid parameters and partial failures explicitly.

title.zh: 立即停止后仍能保存推理档位
title.en: Save thinking settings immediately after stopping

summary.zh: 首字前可停止；保存推理档位时按需静默恢复会话实例，无需先生成一轮回复，旧回包不串改新会话。
summary.en: Stop before the first token and quietly restore the session runtime when saving thinking settings, without requiring another model reply or applying late results to another chat.

sources.title: Pre-stream cancellation and post-abort thinking settings

title.zh: 后台结果去重与停止状态保护
title.en: Deduplicate background results and preserve stopped state

summary.zh: 按运行批次记录完整结果消费，覆盖状态查询与待办查询；续接结果不误吞，停止后的旧循环唤醒不再覆盖新状态。
summary.en: Record full-result consumption per run across status and pending-result queries, preserve continuation results, and discard stale loop wakeups after stopping.

title.zh: 错误、更新状态与界面竞态修正
title.en: Correct error handling, update labels, and UI races

summary.zh: 区分请求过大与限流，移除无依据的重试文案；修复代理指纹、远程卡片票据、折叠偏好和内部标签显示，并区分内容更新与桌面外壳更新。
summary.en: Separate oversized requests from rate limits, remove unsupported retry claims, fix proxy fingerprints, remote card tickets, collapse preferences and internal labels, and distinguish content updates from desktop-shell updates.

sources.title: Retry policy, proxy state, card tickets, and UI consistency

title.zh: 已结束活动历史最多保留七天
title.en: Retain completed activity history for seven days

summary.zh: 已结束记录保留七天、最多一百条；启动、读取和写入时清理，保护运行中记录、共享会话文件、任务配置与工作产物。
summary.en: Retain up to seven days and one hundred completed records, pruning on startup, reads, and writes while protecting active records, shared session files, job definitions, and work products.

details.zh: 过期历史及其专属活动会话会被删除；需要保留旧历史时请先备份。
details.en: Expired history and its dedicated activity-session files are removed; back up older history first if it must be retained.

summary.zh: 跟上 pi 0.85.1。目录有 GPT-6 Astra，思考档和 Codex 速度能对上线上。WebSocket 走同一套代理，OAuth 用量会自己刷新。远程网页的排序和卡片也能用了。
summary.en: Moves onto pi 0.85.1. GPT-6 Astra is in the catalog, thinking levels and Codex speed match the wire, WebSocket uses the same proxy as fetch, OAuth usage refreshes on its own, and remote sort plus cards work.

title.zh: 运行时升到 pi 0.85.1
title.en: Runtime moves to pi 0.85.1

summary.zh: 三件套和 typebox 对齐。凭证改走 ModelRuntime，流包装认新的 streamFunction。
summary.en: The pi trio and typebox are aligned. Credentials go through ModelRuntime, and stream wrappers use streamFunction.

details.zh: AuthStorage 深路径还在适配层里，下次再跟 pi 时只改这一处。
details.en: The AuthStorage deep import stays behind the adapter, so the next pi bump only changes that seam.

title.zh: Codex OAuth 加上 GPT-6 Astra
title.en: GPT-6 Astra on Codex OAuth

summary.zh: 本地目录写入 gpt-6-astra。窗口按 Codex 合同 872K，不是 API 的 1M。
summary.en: The local catalog adds gpt-6-astra. The window follows the Codex contract at 872K, not the API 1M figure.

title.zh: 思考档真正送给模型
title.en: Thinking levels actually reach the model

summary.zh: 补上 thinkingLevelMap。xhigh 和 Max 不再被 pi 钳成 high 或 low。
summary.en: thinkingLevelMap is filled in, so xhigh and Max are no longer clamped to high or low.

title.zh: Codex WebSocket 跟代理走
title.en: Codex WebSocket follows the proxy

summary.zh: 全局 WebSocket 和 fetch 用同一套出站决定，避免直连超时后悄悄退成 SSE。
summary.en: The global WebSocket uses the same outbound decision as fetch, so a direct timeout no longer silently falls back to SSE.

title.zh: Codex 速度档
title.en: Codex speed tier

summary.zh: 标准、快速、超快。快速在线上发 priority。设置和 update_settings 都能切。
summary.en: Standard, fast, and ultrafast. Fast is sent as priority. Settings and update_settings can switch it.

title.zh: OAuth 用量自己刷新
title.en: OAuth usage refreshes itself

summary.zh: 后台轮询用量。暂态失败不再把上次剩余数字擦掉。
summary.en: Usage is polled in the background. A transient failure no longer wipes the last remaining count.

title.zh: 添加模型不再闪关
title.en: Add-model menu stays open

summary.zh: 打开下拉时不再把自动滚动当成点外面。
summary.en: Opening the menu no longer treats the autofocus scroll as an outside click.

title.zh: 远程排序菜单能看见
title.en: Remote sort menu is visible

summary.zh: 远程壳补上 context-menu 的定位，菜单不再画在视口外。
summary.en: The remote shell gets the context-menu positioning, so the menu is no longer painted off-screen.

title.zh: 远程卡片能加载
title.en: Remote cards can load

summary.zh: 卡片接口改走 chat 权限，iframe 带一次性 ticket，不再靠店主钥。
summary.en: Card routes use chat scope, and the iframe carries a one-time ticket instead of an owner key.

summary.zh: 网页搜索改用 Grok 4.1 快模型、并发 4，X 搜索拆成独立工具。后开梯子也能跟上系统代理。侧栏能搜对话，发图、半小时定时、按停圆环这些坑也收了。
summary.en: Web search now uses Grok 4.1 Fast without reasoning, with concurrency 4, and X search is a separate tool. System proxy is picked up if the VPN starts later. Sidebar search, image send, 30-minute schedules, and the abort context ring are fixed.

title.zh: 网页搜索更快，X 搜索改独立
title.en: Faster web search, separate X search

summary.zh: web_search 改走 grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning，并发 4，只搜公开网页。要不要搜 X 由模型自己调 x_search。
summary.en: web_search uses grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning at concurrency 4 and only covers the public web. The model calls x_search on its own when X posts are needed.

details.zh: 不再跟聊天用的 grok-4.6 绑在一起，也不再顺手开看图和 X 搜索。
details.en: Search is no longer bound to chat grok-4.6, and no longer piggybacks image understanding or X search.

title.zh: 后开梯子，系统代理会跟上
title.en: System proxy follows if the VPN starts later

summary.zh: 不再只在开机问一次代理。Windows 系统代理变了会补上环境变量，OAuth 用的 fetch 也走代理。
summary.en: Proxy is no longer frozen at spawn. Windows system proxy changes are stamped into the process, and OAuth fetch uses the proxy too.

title.zh: /loop 可限定轮数
title.en: /loop can cap turns

summary.zh: /loop --turns N 限制循环次数，输入栏有循环状态条。
summary.en: /loop --turns N caps the loop, and the composer shows a loop status bar.

title.zh: 侧栏能搜标题和对话
title.en: Sidebar searches titles and transcripts

summary.zh: 侧栏搜索会高亮命中，空标题也有文案。
summary.en: Sidebar search highlights hits and labels untitled chats.

title.zh: 发图会把像素送给模型
title.en: Pasted images send pixels to the model

summary.zh: 修掉只传路径、服务端收到 0 张图的问题。
summary.en: Fixes the path-only skip that made the server receive 0 images.

title.zh: 30 分钟定时不再显示成每小时
title.en: 30-minute jobs no longer read as hourly

summary.zh: 半小时任务按分钟显示，不再四舍五入成 1 小时。
summary.en: Half-hour jobs stay in minutes instead of rounding to 1 hour.

title.zh: 按停不再抹掉上下文圆环
title.en: Abort no longer clears the context ring

summary.zh: 中止后仍保留上一刀已知用量，圆环不会被空值盖掉。
summary.en: Abort keeps the last known token usage instead of overwriting it with null.

title.zh: 观察压缩会去读会话文件
title.en: Observational compaction reads the session file

summary.zh: 装订笔记时不只翻内存树枝，也会读 jsonl 里已经记下的观察。
summary.en: Prepared notes are collected from the session jsonl, not only the in-memory branch.

title.zh: 定时建议确认后显示已创建
title.en: Schedule suggestions show created after confirm

summary.zh: 点确认后卡片变成已创建，并弹出提示。
summary.en: After confirm, the card shows created and toasts.

summary.zh: 长聊天右侧能跳顶、按轮上下翻、跳到底，回复完成可响 Cursor 那声叮。更新历史改读咱们自己的仓，DeepSeek 能直接发图。侧栏在回答时不再把当前会话顶上去。
summary.en: Long chats get a four-button buoy for true top, previous turn, next turn, and bottom. A Cursor done chime can play when a reply finishes. About history reads our fork, DeepSeek accepts images directly, and the sidebar no longer jumps the current chat while the assistant is answering.

title.zh: 聊天右侧浮标：真顶、上一轮、下一轮、到底
title.en: Chat buoy: true top, previous turn, next turn, bottom

summary.zh: 长聊天只渲染看得见的那一段，跳到顶不再把整段历史一次摊开卡死。四个按钮分别去真正顶部、上一轮用户消息、下一轮、以及底部。
summary.en: Long chats only mount the visible window, so jumping to the top no longer freezes the page. Four buttons go to the true top, the previous user turn, the next turn, and the bottom.

details.zh: 往上翻更早的页时，当前轮会钉住，不会被新加载的旧消息弹回底部。
details.en: Loading older pages pins the current turn so the view does not snap back to the bottom.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: 聊天顶上不再报此区域暂时无法显示
title.en: The top of a long chat no longer blanks out

summary.zh: 量高度时不再死循环把整块聊天区域打爆。到顶也能正常看最早的几轮。
summary.en: Height measuring no longer loops until the chat region crashes. The earliest turns stay visible at the true top.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: 更新历史读咱们自己的仓
title.en: Update history reads our fork

summary.zh: 关于页不再去扒官方 liliMozi 的更新说明。检查更新本来就走咱们仓，历史也对齐。
summary.en: The About page no longer loads official liliMozi notes. Update checks already used our fork; history now matches.

details.zh: 还在跑 0.447.8 时，关于页先展示随包保存的咱们说明，避免主程序仍去问官方。
details.en: On 0.447.8, About shows our bundled notes so the old shell cannot still query the official repo.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: DeepSeek 可直接发图
title.en: DeepSeek accepts images directly

summary.zh: DeepSeek 对话可以带图，不再被目录挡在识图门外。
summary.en: DeepSeek chats can carry images instead of being gated out of vision.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: 回复完成可播放 Cursor 提示音
title.en: Optional Cursor chime when a reply finishes

summary.zh: 设置 → 通用 → 通知里可打开「回复完成时播放提示音」，声音是 Cursor Agent 答完那一声。点停止不响。
summary.en: Settings → General → Notifications can play Cursor's agent-done chime when a turn finishes. Abort stays silent.

details.zh: 默认关着。试听不必先打开开关。
details.en: Off by default. Preview plays without turning the toggle on.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: 回答时侧栏不再把当前会话顶上去
title.en: The sidebar no longer jumps the current chat while answering

summary.zh: AI 还在说话时，当前会话留在原位，项目夹也不会被撑开。
summary.en: While the assistant is streaming, the current session stays put and the project fold does not expand.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: 往上翻旧消息不再弹回底部
title.en: Paging older turns no longer snaps to the bottom

summary.zh: 上一轮按钮加载更早的页时，视线钉在当前轮，而不是从底部再滑一遍。
summary.en: The previous-turn button keeps the current turn in place when older pages prepend.

sources.title: chat timeline, completion chime, DeepSeek vision, fork update history

title.zh: 关于页仓库链接改成咱们的
title.en: About links to our GitHub repo

summary.zh: 关于页的 GitHub 入口指向 Pinging-114514/openhanako。
summary.en: The About GitHub link points at Pinging-114514/openhanako.

summary.zh: 超高和 Max 拆成两档，观察压缩改从会话文件装订笔记并用当前对话模型记账。顺带修好 OTA 代理、Codex 额度和开机空登录。
summary.en: Extra High and Max are separate thinking levels. Observational compaction binds notes from the session file and captures with the current chat model. Also fixes OTA proxy, Codex quota, and empty OAuth at boot.

title.zh: 超高和 Max 分成两档
title.en: Split Extra High and Max

summary.zh: 芯片和发送不再把 Max 偷偷改成超高。Grok 4.6 只有超高，DeepSeek 的 Max 发出去就是 max，Claude 5 和 GPT-5.6 两档都能选。模型编辑页可以勾档位。
summary.en: The UI and request path no longer alias Max to Extra High. Grok 4.6 only has Extra High, DeepSeek Max sends max, and Claude 5 plus GPT-5.6 can pick both. The model editor can toggle the chips.

details.zh: 旧会话里存的 Max，在只有超高的模型上会认成超高，不会凭空多一档。
details.en: A stored Max on a model that only has Extra High is read back as Extra High.

sources.title: split xhigh from max and bind observational notes from the session file

title.zh: 观察压缩从会话文件装订笔记
title.en: Observational compaction binds notes from the session file

summary.zh: 压缩界线后面的笔记不再被丢掉。记账改用当前对话模型，不再走工具模型。JSON 带围栏或写到一半也能尽量收下。
summary.en: Notes behind a compaction boundary are no longer dropped. Capture uses the current chat model instead of the utility model, and messy or truncated JSON is parsed more strictly.

details.zh: 实验页仍要选「观察记忆压缩」。刚重启的第一次若还没新笔记，也可能先走缓存保护。
details.en: Keep Observational memory compaction selected in Experiments. The first compact after a restart may still use cache-preserving if no notes are visible yet.

sources.title: split xhigh from max and bind observational notes from the session file

title.zh: Codex OAuth 额度
title.en: Codex OAuth quota

summary.zh: Provider 页登录后显示 Codex 额度，记忆任务超时加长，减少日记和深记忆半路断掉。
summary.en: The provider page shows Codex quota after login. Memory job timeouts are longer so diary and deep-memory runs are less likely to die mid-way.

sources.title: Codex OAuth quota and longer memory job timeouts

title.zh: OTA 全走梯子代理
title.en: OTA uses the ladder proxy on every GitHub path

summary.zh: 检查更新、下摘要、下安装包都走同一条代理，避免有的请求直连失败。
summary.en: Update checks, digest fetches, and installer downloads all use the same proxy so mixed direct requests stop failing.

sources.title: send every GitHub update path through the ladder proxy

title.zh: 开机重试空的 OAuth 存储
title.en: Retry empty OAuth storage at boot

summary.zh: auth.json 被锁或时钟没对上时，开机不再显示未登录且退出也写不进去。
summary.en: If auth.json is locked or the clock has not settled, boot no longer shows signed-out with a no-op logout.

sources.title: split xhigh from max and bind observational notes from the session file

title.zh: 记忆任务超时加长
title.en: Longer memory job timeouts

summary.zh: Dream、日记编译、深记忆和滚动摘要的等待时间加长。
summary.en: Dream, diary compile, deep-memory, and rolling summary waits are longer.

sources.title: Codex OAuth quota and longer memory job timeouts

summary.zh: 观察记忆压缩、Grok OAuth 搜索和周额度、以及原生回合用量页脚。压缩阈值默认可调。
summary.en: Observational memory compaction, Grok OAuth search with weekly quota, and native turn usage. Auto-compaction threshold is configurable.

title.zh: 观察记忆压缩
title.en: Observational memory compaction

summary.zh: 平时用工具模型记下要点，压缩时直接装订，不再让 Grok 写长摘要。没笔记时退回缓存保护。手动压缩和自动阈值走同一条钩子。
summary.en: Record notes with the utility model while chatting, then bind them at compact time instead of asking Grok to write a long summary. Empty notes fall back to cache-preserving. Manual compact and the auto threshold share the same hook.

details.zh: 实验页手动选中「观察记忆压缩」。刚切过去的第一次若还没笔记，仍可能走缓存保护。
details.en: Select Observational memory compaction in Experiments. The first compact after switching may still use cache-preserving if no notes exist yet.

sources.title: observational compaction, Grok OAuth search, and turn usage backfill

title.zh: Grok OAuth 搜索收进 Hana web_search
title.en: Grok OAuth search inside Hana web_search

summary.zh: 登录 Grok OAuth 后，网页搜和 X 搜走同一刀。Auto 顺序是 OAuth → 付费 API → AnySearch 免费 → 浏览器。Provider 页有搜索开关。
summary.en: After Grok OAuth login, web and X search run in one request. Auto order is OAuth, paid APIs, free AnySearch, then browser. Provider page has a search toggle.

details.zh: 不往聊天请求里注入原生 web_search / x_search，避免吞回复和工具重名。
details.en: Native web_search / x_search are not injected into chat requests, which avoids swallowed replies and duplicate tool names.

sources.title: observational compaction, Grok OAuth search, and turn usage backfill

title.zh: Grok OAuth 周额度
title.en: Grok OAuth weekly quota

summary.zh: Provider 页已登录下方显示本周剩余额度。
summary.en: The provider page shows remaining weekly quota under the signed-in state.

sources.title: observational compaction, Grok OAuth search, and turn usage backfill

title.zh: 原生回合用量页脚
title.en: Native turn usage footer

summary.zh: 回复时间旁显示缓存、入、出、tok/s。Grok 不写 assistant.usage，改从账本按整轮加总。
summary.en: Cache, input, output, and tok/s appear next to the reply time. Grok does not write assistant.usage, so the footer sums the whole turn from the ledger.

sources.title: show turn cache, tokens, and speed next to the reply time

title.zh: 可调自动压缩阈值
title.en: Configurable auto-compaction threshold

summary.en: Experiments can set 50–95%, default 75%.

sources.title: observational compaction, Grok OAuth search, and turn usage backfill

title.zh: 会话按条数折叠，设置不再整页转圈
title.en: Fold sessions by count and stop settings from blocking

summary.zh: 忙项目折叠改成按条数，不再按 3 天。打开设置不再整页 loading，Computer Use 探测只在该页跑。
summary.en: Busy projects fold by count instead of 3 days. Settings no longer show a full-page loader, and Computer Use probing stays on that page.

sources.title: fold busy projects by count and stop settings from blocking on probes

summary.zh: 这一版只构建 Windows，并把 Release 发成正式最新版，热更新直接写入 stable 频道，避免 pre-release 只进 beta 的坑。
summary.en: Windows-only builds, published as the formal latest release so hot updates write the stable channel instead of beta-only prereleases.

title.zh: 只发 Windows 正式版并写入 stable
title.en: Windows-only formal release into stable

summary.zh: 去掉 Linux 构建；Release 不再标 pre-release，publish-train 会更新 stable.json。
summary.en: Drop Linux builds; releases are no longer prerelease, so publish-train updates stable.json.

details.zh: train 是热更新班次；channels/stable.json 是站牌。正式版才会改主站牌。
details.en: A train is a hot-update batch; channels/stable.json is the pointer clients poll.

summary.zh: 这一版继续完善 Pinging fork 发版链路：没有 Apple 签名证书时跳过 macOS 构建，不再挡住 Windows/Linux 安装包和热更新发布。
summary.en: Keeps the Pinging fork release pipeline moving: skip macOS builds when Apple signing certs are absent so Windows/Linux installers and hot updates can still publish.

title.zh: 无 Apple 证书时跳过 macOS，放行 Windows 发版
title.en: Skip macOS without Apple certs so Windows releases can ship

summary.zh: fork 没有 CSC_LINK 时不再因 macOS keychain 步骤失败而跳过 release/publish-train。
summary.en: Without CSC_LINK, macOS keychain failures no longer skip release/publish-train on this fork.

details.zh: 矩阵暂时只保留 Windows 与 Linux；校验清单也改为不强制要求 mac 产物。
details.en: Matrix temporarily keeps Windows and Linux only; release verification no longer requires mac assets.
